finishing.note: finish: 756 bevelled hard edges, 85% smooth-shaded faces, baked atlas at 547.2 px/m from 1 CC0 scans; one UV set (1); 3 PBR PNGs (the atlas: base colour, normal, ORM, 2048 px, the largest 1011089 bytes), every file under 10 MB (largest 1633376 bytes); 3 material slots (frame_atlas, frame_edge_glow, frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE); emissive slot frame_edge_glow on 96 faces; evidence framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0625 of the image, rule 0.03); evidence rendered with Cycles on the CPU. materials: frame_atlas (one 2048 px baked atlas: the rim extrusion in silver-grey aluminium #70777F (metal 0.35) worn bright on its edges, its inner lip in satin aluminium #858C95 (metal 0.3), legs and rails in dark anodised aluminium #262B33, the apron and feet in aluminium #C9CDD2, the corner caps and screws in steel #5A5F66)

frame_edge_glow (emissive edge line: base colour #0A0F18 (dark, so the room's light adds nothing), emission #F4FAFF at strength 3 (glTF emissive_strength), 5 mm wide and 4 mm tall at the paper's edge; UE drives the intensity)
frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE (placeholder plane, base #BFD8F0, alpha 0.15: UE replaces it with the procedural glass and paper)

bounds_cm.note: x,z ground plane, y up (glTF); length 180, depth 90, height 95

pivot: floor centre (x and y at the middle of the 1.80 x 0.90 m outline, z = 0 at the feet); the table stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: Table top surface at 95 cm (wolf-plan W3.2 starts there; R4 lets the owner change it). Outline 1.80 x 0.90 m, a long drafting light table (the owner chose about 180 x 90 cm on 2026-10-24, spark vr-hands-zoom; the first frame was 1.20 x 0.80). The top is 3 cm thick at the outer edge because lamp-agent's manifest says its C-clamp grips a 3 cm table edge; the apron under the top is inset 6 cm so the clamp finds a bare edge. The rim has a 2.8 cm flat top (the concept's slim silver rim, by eye about 2.5 cm beside its 166 cm paper), a 3 mm 45 degree chamfer, and an inner lip sloping 7.2 mm down over 3.4 cm to 6.5 cm in, facing the paper so its light lands there; a 5 mm emissive line (4 mm tall, its top 7.5 mm under the rim top) sits at the paper's edge, so the glass panel is 1.66 x 0.76 m, 0.75 cm below the rim top (UE's paper lies at 0.8 cm). The paper (BpTable.h, 166 x 76 cm) fixes the 7 cm from the outer edge to the glass. The legs stand 8.5 cm in from the sides and, along the length, 8.5 cm in at 1.20 m and further in as the top grows (15 cm at 1.80 m).
textures: frame_atlas_{basecolor,orm,normal}.png: one 2048 px atlas (ORM: R occlusion, G roughness, B metal; normal tangent-space OpenGL), baked with Cycles on the CPU from layered bake sources (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, grunge, AO (multiplied into basecolor at 0.55 too: the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set, long rails cut into 35 cm islands, hidden faces shrunk to 0.12; 547.2 px/m on the visible surface (2.5051 m2). The GLB embeds the atlas as quality-92 JPEG (the 2048 px PNG set would put it over 10 MB). The glow and glass slots are flat colours with no texture.

finish.bevel: angle-limited bevel on every part's hard edges (rim 1.2 mm, lip 0.8 mm, legs 1.2 mm, caps 0.8 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, hardened normals, then weighted normals and smooth shading; 756 hard edges bevelled, 704 kept sharp by design (the glow strip, screw heads), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded
finish.parts: rim: a 3 cm tall extrusion profile with a 6 x 3.5 mm groove on its outer face, a 2.8 cm flat top and a 45 degree chamfer, swept round the outline with mitred corners; inner lip: a second sweep sloping to the 5 mm glow line; 2.5 mm steel corner caps with two screw heads per arm; 4 cm square extrusion legs with a groove down each face, levelling feet

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/light-table-frame/build_frame.bpy (build and score), render_frame.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
licence: own procedural work; no generated input, no Leonardo, ComfyUI or TRELLIS; bake inputs are Poly Haven CC0 scans (blue_metal_plate (https://polyhaven.com/a/blue_metal_plate, CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/license), 2.5 m tile)), never shipped as files

review_fixes.review: Director review of 04fc311 (evidence/turnaround.jpg), 2026-10-21: "the geometry is clean and cheap, but the look departs from the art bible. The table in docs/concepts/vr-light-table/lookdev/00-hero.jpg has a dark, near-black frame with a bright white emissive light strip along the glass edge. The build is warm wood and shows no visible emissive edge." Reworked the same day on the CPU only (Blender, Cycles on the CPU; no ComfyUI, TRELLIS, GPU job or external API).
